title: Guard authorizations (P2.1)
description: Structural, kernel-validated statement of which test deletions and dependency/lockfile changes a job is explicitly allowed to perform. Attached per job at projects/<name>/jobs/<id>/authorizations.json. Authorization is by exact path only: no globs, no wildcards, no pattern prefixes — a human authorizes a concrete file they can name and inspect, which keeps the guard comparison a deterministic string equality and cannot be widened to whole directories by writing one clever entry.

allowed_test_deletions.description: Test file paths (POSIX, relative to the worktree root) that may be deleted or have assertions weakened without triggering no_test_deletion.

allowed_dep_changes.description: Dependency manifest and lockfile paths (POSIX, relative to the worktree root) that may be created/modified without triggering no_lockfile_surprise.

reason.description: Optional human-readable justification. Guards never read this; audit and dashboards may.

authorized_by.description: Optional identity of the human who authorized the exceptions. Guards never read this; audit and dashboards may.
